title: Late Train Home
description: A house track in A minor at 124 BPM, 136 bars (about 4 minutes 23): kick-led intro, bass and clap build, piano stabs over Am7, Fmaj7, Cmaj7 and G7 played through Chord Buddy pads, a soft pad, a two-bar hook, a drum-free breakdown with a snare-roll rise, and a second peak with an octave-doubled hook before the layers leave one by one. Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
